max-w-[140px] mx-auto"></div></div><div id="" class="component general-content "><p>Ventana is a boutique resort located in an area renowned worldwide for windsports like wing foiling, kite surfing,and wind surfing. We have fantastic mountain bike/hiking trail networks close by, along with excellent fishing, diving, and marine wildlife &quot;seafari&quot; adventures. We are located beachfront on the sea of Cortez in Baja California Sur Mexico and offer comfortable and beautiful accommodations, great food and drinks in our restaurant and beach bar, and lots of amenities. "><hgroup><h2>Escape to Baja</h2><p class="subheading" role="doc-subtitle">RELAX IN THE SUN </p></hgroup></div><p>Wake up to breathtaking views each morning. Our rooms &amp; suites are designed with comfort and relaxation in mind. Enjoy our amenities including a beachfront pool, jacuzzi, and fire pit complex. Hammocks, sun loungers, and day beds make for a relaxing area around the pool. Delicious food and drinks are available from our restaurant and beach club. Sip your coffee with a view in the morning and watch the sunset over the sierra each evening.
